scope: Isolated Node page harness and repository business services using in-memory dependencies.
verified: A lost response after a last-credit debit is recoverable from the query page after restart with zero credits. The same SKU and store set reuse the original billing operation. A different store does not offer that recovery. Service executed one upstream call and one debit.
A different account bootstrap discards quota and follow cache belonging to the previous account. Delayed balance and quota updates for the old account cannot replace the current account state.
Unparseable, out-of-order or future success timestamps cannot produce an available status. Freshness uses the time of the confirmed result for query, follow, history and alternative-store actions.
An absent collector object does not interrupt bootstrap of query, history or member pages. Notification readiness distinguishes unconfirmed monitoring state from a known sender failure.
